channel.title: Daily AI News
channel.description: Twice-daily AI news briefing produced by the daily-ai-news Copilot skill.

item.title: Google I/O 2026: Gemini Omni, Gemini 3.5 Flash, and Agentic-First Stack Unveiled
item.description: Google used I/O 2026 to roll out two new flagship Gemini models and reorganize its product line around autonomous agents.

item.title: KPMG to Deploy Anthropic's Claude Across Global Tax and Advisory, Training 30,000 Staff
item.description: KPMG will embed Claude into its global tax and advisory platform and stand up a joint Center of Excellence with Anthropic.

item.title: arXiv Imposes One-Year Ban on Authors Who Let LLMs Write Entire Papers
item.description: arXiv's computer science section will ban authors for a year if a submission contains "incontrovertible evidence" the authors did not check LLM-generated content.

item.title: Mercury Hits $5.2B Valuation on $200M Series D as "Bank for AI Startups"
item.description: AI-startup-focused digital bank Mercury raised a $200M Series D led by TCV, lifting its valuation 49% to $5.2B.

item.title: Exa Raises $250M Series C at $2.2B Valuation to Build "Search Engine for AI Agents"
item.description: AI-native search infrastructure company Exa closed a $250M Series C to scale models and infrastructure designed for autonomous agent queries.

item.title: Google Ships Antigravity 2.0 with Desktop App, CLI, SDK, and Voice Control
item.description: Google launched Antigravity 2.0 at I/O 2026, expanding its agentic coding platform with a redesigned desktop app, a new CLI, and an SDK for custom agents.

item.title: EU AI Act's August 2, 2026 Enforcement Deadline Looms, Most Enterprises Unprepared
item.description: With roughly ten weeks to go, analysts warn that the bulk of EU AI Act obligations for high-risk systems will become enforceable on August 2, 2026, while most enterprises lack basic AI inventories.
